text: Been on hold then waiting for a callback for over 40 mins now so I'm trying this instead. I'm a childminder, have a little boy here, 14 months, his temp is 39.4. He's got a bit of a cough, nothing major. Parents can't be reached until later and I need to know what dose of calpol or ibuprofen I can give him for his age and weight (around 10kg I think). I've checked him all over and there's no rash anywhere, so that's not the issue. I just need the dose please.
